fields.statement: ArgentSea.Sql.csproj's PackageReference to Microsoft.Data.SqlClient (version 7.0.3) carries no Condition attribute: unlike the project file's two Optimize PropertyGroups, which are each conditioned on '$(Configuration)|$(Platform)', the SqlClient reference is declared the same way regardless of configuration or platform as written in this file.
fields.scope: The PackageReference to Microsoft.Data.SqlClient declared in ArgentSea.Sql.csproj.
